Why bad news travels faster than good news.

Kevin explains that if you see a great movie you might mention it, but a terrible one you tell everybody. Negativity is embraced much more easily than positivity.

He says that is why people are so open to the negative influence of others, and why it matters who you let into your head.

Who around you lifts your mood, and who drains it?
